review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend and frontend support for recording user dismissal of observations in the Replay Vision watch feed, including database storage, API endpoints, and telemetry. This could support attribution and recovery of dismissed items.
review.reason: The change group includes a backend model and migration, package exports, and frontend implementation. P1.F11.H1 adds the dismissal state model. P1.F10.H1 and P1.F10.H2 export it. P1.F12.H1, P1.F13.H1, and P1.F14.H1 add frontend types and tests. P1.F24.H9 adds the dismissal action and state. P1.F24, P1.F25, P1.F26, P1.F27, and P1.F28 are not a single change group. P1.F24 and P1.F25
